record.paper_title: Boundary and Defect CFT: Open Problems and Applications
record.original_question: What is the spacetime interpretation of the local gauge symmetry that appears in the bundle of quasi Riemann surfaces, such as the local SU(2)×SU(2) symmetry associated with the self-dual point of the two-dimensional Gaussian model?

evidence.quote: The local gauge symmetry in the bundle of quasi Riemann surfaces needs a space-time interpretation.

artifact.category_tag: quasi Riemann surfaces and gauge symmetry
artifact.self_contained_problem: Consider the bundle of quasi Riemann surfaces associated with a two-dimensional conformal field theory, in particular the two-dimensional Gaussian (free boson) model at its self-dual radius, where an enhanced local SU(2) × SU(2) current algebra symmetry arises. The fibers of this bundle carry a local gauge symmetry, of which the self-dual SU(2) × SU(2) symmetry is a prototypical example. Provide a spacetime interpretation of this local gauge symmetry: identify what the gauge degrees of freedom correspond to as fields or geometric structures on the underlying spacetime (worldsheet and/or target space), and explain how the gauge transformations act on observables of the conformal field theory in geometric or physical terms.
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as an open conceptual problem about interpreting a local gauge symmetry on the bundle of quasi Riemann surfaces. No published resolution providing such a spacetime interpretation was found; the problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Boundary and Defect CFT: Open Problems and Applications
status_evidence.snippet: Collection of open problems in boundary and defect CFT including questions on quasi Riemann surfaces.
status_evidence.claim: The spacetime interpretation of the local gauge symmetry in the bundle of quasi Riemann surfaces is listed as an open problem.
